config.text:
[0-4 秒 Hook]
产品：[名称]。目标用户：[人群]。核心价值：[一句话价值]。画面、口播、表情、屏幕字幕。

[4-10 秒 Pain Point]
画面、口播、快速切镜、真实细节。

[10-23 秒 Product Demo]
屏幕操作、口播反应、产品结果、字幕。

[23-28 秒 Proof]
具体结果、第三方证明、口播。

[28-33 秒 CTA]
自然、低销售感的行动号召。

[33-35 秒 Easter Egg]
自然低声说出的优惠或彩蛋。

nodes.title: 生成 UGC 人物参考图

config.prompt: 根据产品宣传脚本生成一张统一的竖屏 UGC 人物参考图。固定同一个真实、亲切的人物、年龄、发型、服装、光线、房间和手机手持拍摄质感，供所有场景复用。体现产品使用环境，但不要生成可读文字或水印。
以输入的场景脚本为唯一事实来源，生成一段竖屏 UGC 场景，内置口播、自然表演、字幕和手持手机真实感；产品画面必须准确，不得虚构功能，并保持输入的人物参考图一致。

nodes.title: 拼接生成的 UGC 场景

config.prompt: 为这条 UGC 产品宣传视频生成一张 9:16 竖屏封面。保持同一人物和产品环境，突出 Hook 的真实情绪和产品主体，为标题预留干净留白；不要生成可读文字或水印。

metadata.description: 根据统一的人物参考图和可复用的场景脚本生成竖屏 UGC 产品宣传视频。一个文本分割节点拆出多个场景，一个视频节点逐段执行并内置口播、表演、字幕和手机拍摄质感；随后汇总拼接、生成封面，并将封面写入成片。

config.text:
[0-4s Hook]
Product: [name]. Audience: [target user]. Core value: [one sentence]. Visual, spoken line, expression, and on-screen caption.

[4-10s Pain Point]
Visual, spoken line, quick cuts, realistic details.

[10-23s Product Demo]
Screen action, spoken reaction, product result, subtitles.

[23-28s Proof]
Specific result, third-party proof, spoken line.

[28-33s CTA]
Natural low-pressure call to action.

[33-35s Easter Egg]
Bonus tip or offer, whispered naturally.

config.prompt: Create a consistent vertical UGC creator reference image from the product script. Show the same relatable person, wardrobe, age, hair, lighting, room and handheld-phone aesthetic that all scenes can reuse. Include a believable product context, but do not add readable text or watermarks.

Use the supplied scene script as the source of truth. Generate one vertical UGC scene with built-in spoken voice, natural performance, captions, handheld realism, and product-accurate visuals. Keep the supplied creator reference consistent.

Create a vertical 9:16 thumbnail for this UGC product video. Use the same creator and product context, make the Hook emotion immediately readable, leave clean negative space for a headline, and do not generate readable text or watermarks.

metadata.description: Generate a vertical UGC product promotion from one consistent creator reference and a reusable scene script. One text splitter expands the script into scene prompts; one video node runs for each segment, then the scenes are stitched, covered, and embedded in the final video.
